svg.title: An abort in vLLM at the pin: it arrives during a step and is handled before the update
svg.desc: Three lanes against time. The API server lane has a cancel block and then an abort block. A ZMQ arrow runs from the abort block to the input thread's lane, where one block puts the abort on both queues. The main thread's lane has a long block for the forward of step N, and after it an aborts block and an update block. An arrow labelled aborts_queue runs from the queues block to the aborts block, which begins where the forward ends. The abort arrives while the step runs, and it is handled after the forward and before the update.

g.text: the abort arrives while step N runs
it is handled after the forward, before the update
